name: The Boo-chelor
source:
Your favourite Halloween show is back and it's your turn to choose between three, quirky, passionate and... unique dates.

Those are costumes right?

Ask your three suitors questions, set them challenges and in the end choose one to go on the best date of your life... and it very may well be your last.

[From [url=https://glasswing-games.itch.io/the-boo-chelor]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你最喜欢的万圣节表演又回来了，轮到你在三个古怪、热情和……独特的日期中进行选择。

这些是服装吧？

向你的三位追求者提出问题，给他们设置挑战，最后选择一个来进行你一生中最美好的约会……这很可能是你的最后一次。

[来自[url=https://glasswing-games.itch.io/the-boo-chelor]itch.io[/url]]
